title: Cloud Security: invoice allocation
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for invoice allocation.

## Basis

Invoice grouping dimensions: Invoice grouping keys within the customer portfolio; string list.

Unspecified-remittance allocation order: Default allocation of an unspecified remittance; deterministic string.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Invoice grouping dimensions | Unspecified-remittance allocation order |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | legal billing entity, currency, period | invoice issue time, then original source event reference |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | legal billing entity, currency, period | invoice issue time, then original source event reference |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | legal billing entity, currency, period | invoice issue time, then original source event reference |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | legal billing entity, currency, period | invoice issue time, then original source event reference |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | legal billing entity, currency, period | invoice issue time, then original source event reference |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | legal billing entity, currency, period | invoice issue time, then original source event reference |

## Tier comparison

The listed invoice allocation bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
